result.markdown: --- title: "What happens to youth as the result of a technical violation?" format: html --- **What happens to youth as the result of a technical violation?** * Of youth who receive a technical violation as a primary offense, what proportion are placed in a residential facility; detention; committed to state custody? How does this vary across race/ethnicity, sex, and risk level? * Of youth who receive a technical violation as a primary offense, what proportion receive an extended supervision episode? * What is the average length of time a supervision episode is extended as the result of a technical violation? How does this vary across race/ethnicity, sex, and risk level? * In Dallas, probation can file a violation to get a kid into a 30 day residential program. The violation does not go to the prosecutor. If the kid is successful in the placement, then the department dismisses the violation. How often does this happen? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ### pull in dallas data from raw data folder ### set sharepoint path using file.path function (path has different structure than usual so not using csg_sp_path from csgjcr package) sharepoint_jj_av_dallas_raw_data <- file.path("C:/Users/abyrum/The Council of State Governments/JC Research - JJ_AV - JJ_AV/Dallas/Data/raw") ``` ::: ## Table 1. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ### create denominator -- unique referrals for entire sample unique_referrals_sample_denom <- n_distinct(offenses_clean$unique_id, offenses_clean$referral_number) ### create denominator -- unique youth for entire sample unique_youth_sample_denom <- n_distinct(offenses_clean$unique_id) ### unique youth and referrals per year df_referrals_youth_per_year <- offenses_clean %>% dplyr::group_by(referral_year) %>% dplyr::summarise(`Unique Youth (N)` = n_distinct(unique_id), `Unique Referrals (N)` = n_distinct(unique_referral_id), `Referrals, Percent of Sample (%)` = scales::percent(`Unique Referrals (N)`/unique_referrals_sample_denom, accuracy = .1)) %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::rename(`Year of Referral` = referral_year) %>% mutate(`Year of Referral` = as.character(`Year of Referral`)) ### overall df_referrals_youth_overall <- offenses_clean %>% dplyr::summarise(`Unique Youth (N)` = n_distinct(unique_id), `Unique Referrals (N)` = n_distinct(unique_referral_id), `Referrals, Percent of Sample (%)` = scales::percent(`Unique Referrals (N)`/unique_referrals_sample_denom, accuracy = .1)) %>% mutate(`Year of Referral` = "Overall") ### combine tables for kable df_referrals_youth_per_year_table <- rbind(df_referrals_youth_per_year,df_referrals_youth_overall) ### print table via kableextra kable(df_referrals_youth_per_year_table, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), align=rep('c')) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), row_label_position = "l") %>% row_spec(14, bold = TRUE) ``` :::
